svg.title: Affinity against selectivity for every evaluated candidate
svg.desc: Each candidate's GTF-SI affinity against its GTF-SI minus alpha-amylase selectivity, with the lead marked.
svg.text: The lead is not on the frontier of its own leaderboard
86 of 260 candidates score better than the lead on both axes at once. 3 are dominated by nothing in the set.
AutoDock Vina affinity against GTF-SI (kcal/mol), lower is better
dominated by nothing in the set
Points are not coloured by the ledger's falsification status, because 36 of the 39 rows it labels SUBTHRESHOLD_AFFINITY clear the affinity gate and fail a different criterion.
Drawn from data/contenders_ledger.csv, all 260 rows. Dominance is computed here, not read from the pareto_rank column, which restates the status.
